Coverage-Aware TUBELEX Frequency and Prevalence Profile

tubelex_profile.Rd

Look up surface-form frequency, video prevalence, and channel prevalence in the byte-pinned TUBELEX-EN Treebank aggregate downloaded separately via lexdiv_download_resources.

Usage

tubelex_profile(
  terms,
  normalization = "tubelex",
  tokenization_mismatch = "error"
)

tubelex_profile_batch(
  documents,
  normalization = "tubelex",
  tokenization_mismatch = "error",
  id_col = "document_id",
  terms_col = "terms",
  max_rows = 1e6
)

# S3 method for class 'tubelex_profile'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'tubelex_profile_batch'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'tubelex_profile_batch'
plot(
  x,
  weighting = c("token", "type"),
  col = "#0072B2",
  main = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  ...,
  monochrome = FALSE
)

Arguments

terms

An ordered character vector of Treebank-aligned terms, or a lexdiv_tokenization object with tokenization_mismatch = "allow".

normalization

"tubelex", "tubelex_apostrophe", or "identity".

tokenization_mismatch

"error" (default) or "allow".

documents

Named list of term vectors/tokenizations, or a data frame/tibble with id_col and terms_col.

id_col, terms_col

Column names for data-frame input.

max_rows

Positive whole-number row bound checked before resource loading.

x

A tubelex_profile or tubelex_profile_batch object.

weighting

Weighting ("token" or "type") for batch coverage barplot.

col, main, ylab

Base-R barplot styling arguments.

monochrome

Logical switch for black/grey barplot styling.

...

Additional arguments passed to print.data.frame() or graphics::barplot().

Value

tubelex_profile() returns a tubelex_profile list containing status, failure_reason, summary, lookup, coverage, provenance, and diagnostics.

tubelex_profile_batch() returns a structured tubelex_profile_batch object containing document-major summary, lookup, and coverage tables alongside profiles (the input-ordered named list of complete per-document tubelex_profile objects), provenance, and diagnostics.

See also

tubelex_diagnostics, lexdiv_download_resources

Examples

if (all(lexdiv_resource_info("tubelex")$available)) {
  tokens <- c("I", "do", "n't", "think", "it", "'s", "John", "'s", "book")
  profile <- tubelex_profile(tokens)
  print(profile)

  batch <- tubelex_profile_batch(list(d1 = tokens, d2 = c("hello", "world")))
  print(batch)
  plot(batch)
}
